titles.romaji: Tottoko Hamtaro OVA 3: Hamuchanzu to Niji no Kuni no Oujisama - Sekai de Ichiban no Takaramono
titles.native: ハムちゃんずと虹の国の王子さま 〜せかいでいちばんのたからもの〜

description:
Based on the third Hamtaro game (fourth in Japan), Prince Bo falls from the sky when the rainbow disappears. Now Hamtaro and the Ham-Hams must help him bring back the rainbow.

(Source: Wikipedia)
